messages.author: a0c9c53065dc7f03
messages.subject: nonwearscore>=1 how GGIR handle the data for nonwear time
parts:
Hi,

I am using 

             ignorenonwear = TRUE,
when I processed the GGIR for my GeneActive data. I am wondering how GGIR generate output for those nonwear time (with nonwearscore=1,2,3).
should I do imputation by myself for those nonwear interval when I am reading .csv file.


Thanks.
Best,
Dora

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] nonwearscore>=1 how GGIR handle the data for nonwear time
parts:
Hi Dora,
This argument is specific to the sleep detection and does not affect the imputation done elsewhere (functions g.part2 and g.impute) in the package.
Best, Vincent
